profiles.name: Open Banking
profiles.description: Account, balance, and transaction data pulled under an open-banking consent flow (PSD2/UK Open Banking style). Evidence is the bank/AISP-issued statement of account state at a point in time.
profiles.notes: No shipped chain consumes this profile yet. Consent metadata rides §23 freshness.consent_ref.

profiles.name: Sanctions Screening
profiles.description: Watchlist/sanctions-list screening results (OFAC, UN, EU consolidated lists) asserted against a named entity or counterparty at screening time.
profiles.notes: No shipped chain consumes this profile yet. List-vintage freshness matters more than sub-day latency.

profiles.name: Market Data
profiles.description: Priced instrument or index data (FX rate, security price, benchmark rate) as observed at a source at a given instant.
profiles.notes: No shipped chain consumes this profile yet.

profiles.name: Custody / Reserve
profiles.description: Proof-of-reserve or custody-balance attestation: a custodian or issuer asserts holdings back a liability at a snapshot instant.

profiles.name: Registry / KYB
profiles.description: Business-registry or Know-Your-Business record (incorporation status, beneficial ownership, registry filings) as published by an official or authorized registry.
profiles.notes: No shipped chain consumes this profile yet. Registry filings change rarely; freshness_class is deliberately static rather than daily.

profiles.name: Chain State
profiles.description: On-chain or ledger state proof (balance, contract state, transaction inclusion) at a specific block height or ledger instant.
